label: PF Backlog 699
title: Retrieval & Context Evaluation: Precision@k, Recall@k, faithfulness scoring, ground-truth benchmark suite, and latency observability
body:
## Problem / why
No quantitative evaluation exists to measure if retrieved context is accurate, relevant, or hallucination-inducing.

## Goal & value
Build an automated evaluation harness measuring retrieval precision, recall, faithfulness, and latency across backends.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-24`

## In scope
- Evaluation harness computing Precision@k, Recall@k, MRR, and NDCG.
- Golden query-document benchmark dataset for Product Forge.
- Latency and context efficiency metrics exported to test reports.

## Out of scope
- Manual ad-hoc human-only grading.

## Definition of Done
- Evaluation harness integrated into CI with automated pass/fail assertions.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
